style: Say in a clear, informative way, like a nature documentary narrator
lines: Welcome, guest director. Five theaters, one scene. Tap a theater to begin.
The Greek theater: the chorus lives in the round orchestra. Read the rules, then tap Begin.
The Noh stage: a bridge, four pillars and a painted pine. Read the rules, then tap Begin.
A commedia stage in the square: masks, tricks and a crowd. Read the rules, then tap Begin.
The Globe, by daylight, with the crowd on three sides. Read the rules, then tap Begin.
A realist room with its fourth wall. Read the rules, then tap Begin.
Read the beat, then tap Next beat to move on, or Play scene to watch it run.
Tap one of the two choices. Then watch from a seat and read what the audience notices.
Tap Seat to watch the same moment from somewhere else.
Program note written. Tap Back to tour for the next theater.
Two theaters staged. Tap Compare to see them side by side.
You've directed all five. Tap Compare to see them side by side.
Tap a beat number. Every theater you staged shows that moment side by side.
